plasticStyle: Studio catalogue photograph of a single unpainted hard-plastic wargaming miniature, roughly 32mm heroic scale, cast in bare monochrome polystyrene with a subtle satin plastic sheen and crisp sculpted detail — no paint, no wash, no decals, a uniform single-colour model straight off the sprue. The figure stands on a small round textured hobby base sculpted as cracked salt-flat crust. Soft even studio softbox lighting from the upper left with a gentle cool rim light, set on a clean seamless neutral light-grey gradient backdrop with a soft contact shadow beneath the base. Three-quarter front hero angle, the whole figure framed full-length with a little headroom, sharp focus across the model, shallow tabletop depth of field falling off behind it. It must read as a real product photo of the actual plastic model — NOT a painting, NOT cover art, NOT a battlefield diorama. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, paint or colour of any kind beyond the single plastic tone, and no scenery beyond the salt-crust base.
